en.headline: Health Bureau launches community drug formulary with 151 medicines from 30 December
en.dek: The formulary expands coverage to urological, ophthalmic and dermatological conditions, with non-patented drugs at HK$2 per item per week.
body: The Health Bureau announced on Wednesday that the Community Drug Formulary will take effect from 30 December, replacing the basic drug list for family doctors in the primary healthcare co-care network.

The formulary covers 151 medicines, adding 38 items including five patented drugs and 33 non-patented ones to the existing 113. New coverage includes urology, ophthalmology and dermatology, beyond the previous focus on diabetes, hypertension and other chronic conditions.

Tier 1 non-patented medicines will cost HK$2 per item per week, while Tier 2 patented medicines cost HK$30. The bureau said new items are priced at about one-tenth to one-third of market rates. Each network participant receives an annual HK$200 subsidy for Tier 1 drugs, and eligible elderly can use medical vouchers.

About 70,000 patients who have completed screening for three highs or chronic hepatitis B and entered treatment will benefit first. The government aims to expand the list to 200-400 medicines over time.

zh.headline: 醫衞局公布社區藥物名冊下月30日推出涵蓋151項藥物
zh.dek: 名冊新增38項藥物，擴闊至泌尿科、眼科及皮膚科，非專利藥物每項每星期2元，並提供每年200元藥費資助。
body: 醫務衞生局今日公布，社區藥物名冊將於十二月三十日起推出。基層醫療共同治理網絡下的家庭醫生處方藥物時，將由現時的基本藥物名單轉為採用名冊的藥物。
名冊共涵蓋151項藥物，在現時慢病共治計劃的113項基本藥物名單之上新增38項，包括5項專利藥物和33項非專利藥物。新增藥物將覆蓋範圍擴闊至泌尿科、眼科及皮膚科等疾病類別。
名冊設三個層級，第一層為146項非專利藥物，藥費每項每星期2元；第二層為5項專利藥物，每項每星期30元。新增藥項的病人藥費僅為市價約十分之一至三分之一。政府為每名共同治理網絡參加者提供每年200元藥費資助，直接扣減第一層藥物費用。
約7萬名已完成「三高」或慢性乙型肝炎篩查並進入治療階段的病人將率先受惠。當局期望長遠可涵蓋200至400項藥物。
